size.value: 5cm x 5cm (fotografía a color del rostro, tamaño pasaporte)

file_spec.value: Physical color print, glued ("pegada") onto the designated space on the first page of the printed visa application form — not a digital upload

db_conflicts.research_value: 5cm × 5cm (50mm × 50mm) — stated explicitly in metric by the DGME-authorized visa requirements document ("Una fotografía a color del rostro, de 5 cm x 5 cm, con fondo blanco, tamaño pasaporte"); 50mm differs from the DB's 51mm (2-inch) figure

cross_verification.note: Source is a DGME (Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería)-authorized visa requirements document distributed via the Embassy of Costa Rica (for its Colombia consular jurisdiction), explicitly labeled 'VISA AUTORIZADA POR LA DIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE MIGRACIÓN Y EXTRANJERÍA DE COSTA RICA (DGME)'. The document only specifies size, background, and physical/glued submission format — it does not detail head height, expression, glasses, headwear, or other restriction fields, which remain unverified. Costa Rica's general migracion.go.cr visa portal (migracion.go.cr/visas/) and its generic 'Requisitos para las visas consulares' checklist do not itemize a photo requirement at all, suggesting photo specifics may only appear in jurisdiction-specific consular instructions such as this one.
